decision.reason: [ev-3061dab5ee67] is just one changelog line saying that main was reverted to 0.15.1 in PR #4657. It doesn't name any field, API, flag or behaviour affected by the revert, and it doesn't give a before/after value. It also doesn't say what happens to an operator who does nothing. The line sits under a BREAKING CHANGES heading but only points to the PR, and a whole-branch revert probably bundles several changes, so we need the PR diff or the release notes that say what the revert undid.
